TYPES OF ARTICLES
Persuasive Entertainment Informative Warning

PERSUASIVE ARTICLES
• Persuasive articles, also known as persuasive essays or opinion pieces, are written texts that
aim to persuade the reader to adopt the author's viewpoint or opinion on a particular topic.
• These articles are commonly found in newspapers, magazines, blogs, and other media outlets.
• The primary purpose of persuasive articles is to present arguments, evidence, and reasoning in
a compelling and convincing manner, with the goal of influencing the reader's beliefs,
attitudes, or behaviors.

ENTERTAINMENT
ARTICLES
• Entertainment articles are written pieces that focus
on topics related to the world of entertainment, such
as movies, television shows, music, celebrities, pop
culture, events, and trends.
• These articles aim to inform, entertain, and engage
readers who have an interest in the entertainment
industry and its various aspects.

INFORMATIVE ARTICLES
Informative articles, also known as informative essays or informative pieces, are written texts that aim
to provide readers with information, explanations, or insights on a specific topic that is all factual.
These articles are designed to educate and enlighten readers about a particular subject matter in a
clear and objective manner.
The primary purpose of informative articles is to present information in a way that is easy to
understand and accessible to a wide range of readers.
They typically cover a diverse range of topics, including science, technology, history, health, education,
travel, culture, and more.
Informative articles can be found in newspapers, magazines, academic journals, websites, blogs, and
other sources of information.

WARNING ARTICLES
• Warning articles, also known as cautionary articles or
advisory pieces, are written texts that aim to alert
readers about potential dangers, risks, or hazards
associated with specific situations, products,
practices, or behaviors.
• These articles serve as a means of informing and
educating the public about potential threats or
harmful consequences, with the goal of promoting
safety and preventing negative outcomes.
• Warning articles can cover a wide range of topics,
including health warnings, safety precautions,
product recalls, environmental risks, financial scams,
cyber threats, travel advisories, and more.
• They are commonly found in news outlets,
government websites, consumer protection
organizations, industry publications, and other
sources of public information.

How to Skim?
Look at the beginning of
each paragraph (1-2 sentences)
Read the first few sentences
or first paragraph carefully
Read only the words that will
help support the main idea of the text
Usually, the topic sentence is somewhere
at the beginning (First 2 paragraphs)
Skip some paragraphs
that are not important.
Read the last paragraph carefully
